notes: Fixture domain for the conformance corpus. Invariant I-6: every table and column referenced anywhere in the corpus must exist here.

Negative contract (P:attachments-are-out-of-protocol-scope, AT:media-attachments): the domain deliberately has no attachment columns, attachment bytes never ride the row channel, and the seed exercises no attachment_id references.

bucket_column mirrors kizunasync._config.bucket_column (SQL:config-bucket-column): the declared, indexed owner column (scope: owner/tenant equality, P:mutations-and-column-masked-conflict-resolution Bucket).

key_columns mirrors kizunasync._config.key_columns (SQL:config-key-columns): the table's primary-key columns in order, whose text is every pk the corpus carries for the table (D-row-key). notices is keyed by one bigint and seats by a (bigint, integer) pair.
